skill_name: Describe the differences between e-commerce and conventional business.
workflow: The primary difference between e-commerce and conventional businesses is the way they conduct their business operations. E-commerce businesses transact digitally and use electronic technologies to facilitate various transactions including customer acquisition, product sales, and payments, whereas traditional businesses rely on physical infrastructure and face-to-face customer engagement.
